title: Assessment of Employment Landscape for Polytechnic Graduates in 2025
what_it_is: Assessment of Employment Landscape for Polytechnic Graduates in 2025

sections.label: Polytechnic graduate employment survey 2024
sections.summary: 2024 saw lower hiring demand and fewer vacancies than 2023, and among economically active polytechnic graduates, full-time permanent employment fell and unemployment rose.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: While the labour market remained tight in 2024, with job vacancies remaining higher than pre-pandemic levels, 2024 saw lower hiring demand and fewer vacancies compared to 2023, which would have contributed to the survey findings for 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Based on the 2024 Graduate Employment Survey conducted by the five polytechnics, about 45% of graduates were economically active.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Among this group, there was a decrease in the full-time permanent employment rate and an increase in the unemployment rate as compared to 2023.

sections.label: Polytechnic graduates continuing further studies
sections.summary: The number of polytechnic graduate students continuing further studies has increased.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The first is that the number of polytechnic graduate students that are continuing further studies has increased.

sections.label: Unemployment uptick among working graduates
sections.summary: Those going directly into work are the remaining 45%, within which there was an uptick of about 5% in unemployment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: That is, in some sense, a positive trend.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Then, those who go directly into work are the remainder 45% or so, and within this 45%, that is where we get the uptick of last year, about a 5% of this 45%, in change in the unemployment.

sections.label: Polytechnic graduates entering degree courses
sections.summary: The cohort participation rate for students entering universities is 42% now, compared to previously.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: I note Minister's points about the transit of polytechnic graduates into degree courses and understandably so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: I think in the previous decade, MOE had also envisage the cohort participation rate for students entering universities to be on the increase and it is 42% now compared to previously.

sections.label: Work-Study diploma and degree programmes
sections.summary: Work-Study diploma and degree programmes are applied learning programmes with industry, and the number of Work-Study programmes is hoped to be expanded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The second thing that has come through here is also, increasingly, we have what we call the Work-Study diploma or Work-Study degree.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: These are applied learning programmes in collaboration with the industries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: This is also another strong mechanism for us to make sure that our courses are relevant and are able to meet the just-in-time demand of the industries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We hope to be able to expand the number of Work-Study programmes, because this will make it more current, not just for the pre-employment training, but also for the continuing education and training.
